InvoiceId: fully null in this delivery — no invoice number is available for deduplication.
One delivery snapshot only. Billing revisions have not been observed.
Currency: USD for all 12,200 rows.

blocked_analyses.blocked_by: No verified shared identifier between CALIBUR admission records and FOCUS billing records has been established.  Tags field is fully empty in both deliveries; ResourceId is null for 606 of 12,200 rows.

No billing-record arrival timestamp is present in the FOCUS 1.2 schema.  BillingPeriodStart/End and ChargePeriodStart/End are billing-period boundaries, not arrival times.  Arrival delay cannot be measured without a separate arrival timestamp.

No verified row-level unique key has been established for FOCUS records.  InvoiceId is fully null.  Snapshot comparison used only descriptive grouping fields.  Two snapshots differing does not prove a billing revision.
No empirical linkage between admission decisions and billing outcomes has been established.  Profiling alone does not validate real-world controller performance.

unresolved_quality_issues.issue: AWS account-ID discrepancy in FOCUS delivery metadata
unresolved_quality_issues.detail: S3 delivery path uses account ID <redacted-account>.  Export ARN in CALIBUR_FOCUS_12-Manifest.json uses account ID <redacted-account>.  These differ by one digit (penultimate position: '1' vs '2').  The correct account ID has not been confirmed.  Neither value will be corrected or guessed until confirmed by the account owner.
unresolved_quality_issues.status: UNRESOLVED — requires confirmation from the account owner

unresolved_quality_issues.detail: The Alibaba clusterdata repository contains a CC BY 4.0 license file.  Whether that license applies specifically to the v2017 trace archive (alibaba-trace-2017.tar.gz) has not been independently confirmed.  The source remains unapproved for research use until this is established.

The extracted container_event.csv contains 9 columns.  The authoritative schema (trace_201708.md, alibaba_v2017_schema.csv) documents only 8.  The 9th column is always blank in the v2017 archive.  Its semantics are unknown.  It is preserved as 'undocumented_field_9' in the loader schema without interpretation.
unresolved_quality_issues.status: UNRESOLVED — semantics of 9th column not documented by source

unresolved_quality_issues.issue: No verified row-level unique key for FOCUS billing records
unresolved_quality_issues.detail: FOCUS 1.2 does not mandate a row-level stable ID field.  InvoiceId is fully null in both deliveries.  ResourceId is null for 606 of 12,200 rows in Delivery 1.  No substitute key has been invented.  Snapshot comparison used descriptive grouping only and must not be treated as row-level identity comparison.
unresolved_quality_issues.status: UNRESOLVED — no unique row key established
